messages:
alex (sales): Heads-up — FinVue POC kickoff next Tue 9am PT. They want a fast win: accurate invoice extraction + line-item matching, and a fallback reranker for low-confidence reads. Need to align success criteria and model choices.

sarah (solutions): Re: success criteria — can we land on: 1) 95% top-1 field accuracy, 2) <300ms median latency for single-page reqs, 3) end-to-end rerank precision@3 > 90% on their validation set? Those map to product asks.

tom (ml eng): Those are reasonable. Question: do they require >32k context? They mentioned multi-page invoices but I think 8k with smart chunking + embeddings could work. @alex can you confirm doc sizes?

alex (sales): Most docs are 3–6 pages, scanned PDFs. OCR output ~3–6k tokens each, but they want cross-page lineage matching (same invoice series). So we might need up to ~18k for combined context in some flows.

marco (infra): If we expect ~18k, hosted 32k models are fine. If they need on-prem / Dedicated we should discuss memory and quantization tradeoffs. Also consider routing to a cheaper 8k model for single-page calls and to 32k for cross-page ops.

jess (security): FinVue sent a security questionnaire — they require KMS integration, audit logs, and STS-based role separation. Also a data retention clause: PII must be purged after 30 days. That impacts caching strategy.

tom (ml eng): Good catch on retention. We can disable persistent prefix caching for PII flows and use ephemeral KV. For reranker/embeddings: propose using embeddings + FAISS-style vector store in customer VPC (Private) or we use hosted embeddings with dedicated capacity if they can't allow external storage.

sarah (solutions): For evals — can we get a 200-example prompt set from FinVue (real invoices redacted)? We can run perf matrix: models {redwood-8k, redwood-32k, off_the_shelf-quant}. Measure accuracy, latency, tokens/call, and cost. Target: pick smallest model that meets success metrics.

alex (sales): I'll request the 200 examples and also ask them to fill a short runbook: typical QPS, busiest hour, and whether they need SLA. Pricing question: they asked whether POC can be covered under hosted credits or requires a Dedicated trial. Any opinion?

marco (infra): If QPS < 5 and latency SLO is 300ms median, hosted should be fine for POC. If they need isolation for security, use Private trial — that triggers enterprise onboarding and affects timeline (+2 weeks).

jess (security): Also note: customer insists on ability to disable tool-calling features (external web/tool access) in case of sensitive data. That must be a configurable flag in the POC config.

tom (ml eng): Tool calling off is trivial. For reranking approach: pipeline option A = embeddings + approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) + learned reranker; pipeline B = seq2seq rerank with full context. A is cheaper, B likely higher precision for tricky lineage cases. We'll benchmark both.

alex (sales): Great. Action items: 1) I’ll get 200 redacted examples + QPS details (by EOD Wed). 2) @tom run initial accuracy/latency sweep on redwood-8k and -32k with both pipelines (ETA Thu). 3) @jess confirm whether the security answers allow hosted embeddings or require VPC (ETA Thu). 4) @marco estimate Dedicated/Private trial lead time and cost delta (ETA Fri).

sarah (solutions): For acceptance criteria doc — I'll draft a 1-page POC playbook mapping user story -> eval prompt -> pass/fail thresholds and send for review. Quick template snippet:

```text
User story: Auto-extract invoice total + match line items across pages
Eval set: 200 redacted invoices
Metric: top-1 field accuracy, rerank precision@3
Pass: accuracy >=95% AND precision@3 >=90% AND median latency <300ms
```

alex (sales): Perfect. If all goes well we propose rolling into a 3-month Dedicated pilot with commit targets. One blocker: FinVue legal asked if we can sign their standard DPA for a POC — is that OK?

jess (security): We usually sign DPA for POCs after review. Send their DPA to legal@redwood and mark as POC; expect 3–5 business days.

qa-bot: Reminder: add the POC thread to #poc-tracker and create a shared folder for artifacts (evals, configs, SQS logs). :robot_face:

alex (sales): Thanks — will update PRD and add to tracker after I get the sample set. Ping if anything slips.
